hero.body: Slow-cooked Habesha stews, fresh injera, and Ethiopian coffee from Putney, South West London. Send us a WhatsApp message and CultureGlow24 delivers.

story.body: CultureGlow24 is more than a restaurant; it is the story of our family, of tables gathered around, of laughter shared, of recipes treasured and passed lovingly from one generation to the next. Our cuisine is born from Ethiopian roots — each dish a reflection of where we come from, flavours shaped by history, refined with care, and presented with elegance. From our Putney base we share injera, coffee ceremony, and Habesha hospitality across London.
story.amharic: Welcome to CultureGlow24! This is where our new chapter begins, and we are honoured to share it with you.

kitchen.body: We simmer the stews slowly, bake the injera fresh, and cook from recipes our families handed down. Nothing here comes out of a shortcut.

catering.body: From intimate family gatherings to full wedding receptions, our catering team brings the same authentic flavor and warm hospitality to every table we serve.
